title: Measuring Social Bias in Vision-Language Models with Face-Only Counterfactuals from Real Photos

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using face-only counterfactual image edits from real photographs that vary racial presentation (White, Black, Asian, Latino, Middle Eastern) across decision-oriented tasks, including Two-Alternative Forced Choice (2AFC) comparisons, categorical Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQ), and numeric salary recommendations.

Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using face-only counterfactual image edits from real photographs that vary gender presentation (Male, Female) across decision-oriented tasks, including Two-Alternative Forced Choice (2AFC) comparisons, categorical Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQ), and numeric salary recommendations.
